definitions.gloss: health checkup; health screening; medical examination
definitions.explanation: A general health examination to check one's overall physical condition. Short for {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}. Includes routine checkups at workplaces and community health screenings.

examples.japanese: {年|ねん}に{一度|いちど}{健診|けんしん}を{受|う}ける。
examples.english: Have a health checkup once a year.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{健診|けんしん}で{引|ひ}っかかった。
examples.english: Something came up in my company health checkup.

examples.japanese: {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{健診|けんしん}は{市区町村|しくちょうそん}が{無料|むりょう}で{実施|じっし}している。
examples.english: Infant health checkups are provided free of charge by municipal governments.

notes:
USAGE:
Short for {健康診断|けんこうしんだん}. In Japan, annual health checkups are mandated by law for employees. Community-based screenings are also widely offered for residents.

NOTE: Not to be confused with the homophone {検診|けんしん}, which refers to screening for a specific disease (e.g., {癌|がん}{検診|けんしん}, cancer screening). {健診|けんしん} is a general checkup; {検診|けんしん} targets a specific condition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {健診|けんしん}を{受|う}ける (to have a health checkup)
- {健診|けんしん}{結果|けっか} (checkup results)
- {定期|ていき}{健診|けんしん} (regular health checkup)
- {乳幼児|にゅうようじ}{健診|けんしん} (infant health checkup)
